sections.title: Programme reviews
sections.sql: select source_id,name,owner,review_on from programmes where status='active' order by review_on

sections.title: Upcoming sessions
sections.sql: select programme,session,scheduled_on,owner,capacity_units,unit from v_session_roster where status='planned' and scheduled_on>=current_date order by scheduled_on

sections.title: Targets by benefit and unit
sections.sql: select programme,benefit,unit,target_units,delivered_units,future_capacity_units from v_benefit_capacity order by programme,benefit

sections.title: Overdue work
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by due_on

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by rule
